verdict.rationale: The Zoho Books features page is cited as documenting an audit trail, alongside accountant access to journal entries and reports. That is only a single passing mention, with no detail on what the trail records or how far it extends. Missing for 10: evidence that it captures who changed what and when, evidence that it covers every ledger transaction type and setting, details on filtering, export or retention, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
